definitions.explanation: The visible shape or outline of a person or thing.
How someone or something looks; outward appearance.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{姿|すがた}が{見|み}えなくなった。
{着物|きもの}{姿|すがた}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: She looks beautiful in a kimono.

examples.japanese: {働|はたら}く{姿|すがた}を{見|み}て{感動|かんどう}した。
examples.english: I was moved by seeing them work.

notes:
{姿|すがた} refers to a person's visible form or appearance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～{姿|すがた} (appearance in..., figure wearing...)
- {姿|すがた}が{見|み}える (one's figure is visible)
- {姿|すがた}を{消|け}す (to disappear)
- {姿|すがた}を{現|あらわ}す (to appear, to show up)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {着物|きもの}{姿|すがた} (appearance in kimono)
- {後|うし}ろ{姿|すがた} (figure from behind)
- {本来|ほんらい}の{姿|すがた} (true form/nature)
- {姿|すがた}{形|かたち} (form and shape)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {姿|すがた}: figure, appearance (visual form of a person)
- {形|かたち}: shape, form (of objects)
- {外見|がいけん}: outward appearance
